summary.one_liner: Monica is an open-source, self-hostable personal relationship management (PRM) web app for documenting your life, logging interactions with family and friends, and getting reminders about them.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Monica as a web application for managing contacts, relationships between them, and interactions with family and friends. It offers contact management with notes, how-you-met records, activities, tasks, addresses and contact fields, plus reminders including automatic birthday reminders sent by email. It includes a diary for logging daily events, document and photo uploads, pet tracking, labels, favorites, and support for multiple vaults and users. It also lists multiple currencies and translations into 27 languages. The README explicitly says it is not a social network, not AI-driven, and not ad-supported. This branch is a beta; the README points to the 4.x branch for the stable version.
use_cases: keep track of friends and family details
log interactions and how the day went
store notes on how you met people
notable: Personal relationship management (PRM) framed as a CRM for friends and family
Automatic birthday reminders and custom reminders sent by email
Multiple vaults and users, custom genders and activity types
Translated into 27 languages with multiple currencies
Explicit privacy stance: no tracking, no ads, no built-in AI
caveats: This branch is in development and described as beta; the stable version is on the 4.x branch
The README gives no install or run instructions; it links to a Contribution Guide and developer setup
Paid account and Patreon support are mentioned as options
